description:
We are two friends from Paysandú, Uruguay, who want to bring science closer to curious people of all ages, especially children and teenagers interested in space.

We are students, and we are looking forward to challenging ourselves and exceeding our limits. Our main goal is to approach science through engaging storytelling.
summary:
What happens to the equipment astronauts leave behind in space? Every object has a story worth discovering!
REDISCOVERING SPACE is an interactive educational adventure that takes children on a journey across the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space to explore NASA equipment left behind during real space missions.
By combining storytelling, NASA data, and interactive challenges, our project turns scientific information into an engaging experience. Players become astronauts, discover forgotten equipment, collect information, and test their knowledge through a final challenge.
Our goal is to make space science fun and accessible while encouraging curiosity and inspiring the next generation to explore, learn, and look beyond Earth.
details:
REDISCOVERING SPACE is an interactive educational adventure where children become astronauts and explore the Moon, Mars, and Deep Space to discover NASA equipment left behind during real space missions.

Through short information cards based on NASA data, players learn about forgotten equipment, complete a discovery checklist, and face a final challenge on Earth.

Our project makes space science more accessible and enjoyable, encouraging curiosity, exploration, and learning through play. Its creativity lies in combining real scientific information, storytelling, and interactive games to turn learning into an adventure.

Tools used:

  • Genially: Interactive experience.
  • Google Sheets & Docs: Data organization and research.
  • Canva: Presentation design.
  • Gemini: Backgrounds.
  • Recraft AI: Characters and image editing.
  • Stable Audio: Background music.
  • ChatGPT: English proofreading and project support.

No programming languages or specific hardware were used.

We considered our young audience, focusing on simple navigation, clear information, attractive visuals, and reliable NASA sources.

Our mission is to bring forgotten discoveries back into the spotlight and inspire the next generation of space explorers. Because in space, nothing should be forgotten!
